# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: VIE 1970 on actions — event hooks.
## COLDWAR | North Vietnam 1970. Generated by tools/vietnam_1970/compile.py.
## Immutable approved input; implementation and English prose live in tools/vietnam_1970.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			VIE = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes }
					COLDWAR_VIE_initialize = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes }
				COLDWAR_VIE_daily_update = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes }
				COLDWAR_VIE_sync_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_VIE_is_1970 = yes }
				COLDWAR_VIE_sync_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
